decisions.reason: This software is highly aligned with the firm's core automation and digital infrastructure direction, and even after several years it remains a relatively low-cost option to retain because it can be sold or embedded in broader solutions.

This hardware niche fits the customer base but sits outside the firm's main data-driven trajectory, and after several years with limited visible momentum the remaining option value looks too low to justify continued attention.

Control technology for water engineering machinery is central to the firm's established engineering and automation capabilities, so it is worth retaining as a core offer while continuing to support project-based demand.

Flow measurement automation and system software matches the firm's move toward connected and data-based operations, and keeping it on the market preserves upside while the commercial potential of this newer offer continues to clarify.
